lines: - Olvar D: "I will never forget the man who gave his life for us. The man whose sacrifice showed us the way. We honor his name. Veko."
- Olvar D: "So... most Solaris don't like what they do. Huh. Though Chipper did offer to take off my head so I could see if I liked it."
- Olvar D: "Deep-fried Pobber sure takes some getting used to. Fortunately, my suit's recyc system is still online."
- Olvar D: "I tried cooking. Horrek was very excited about it. How do I treat burns?"
- Olvar D: "Jarka seems nice. I told her that we were taught the Grineer hated people like me. She told me I was right. See? Grineer helping Corpus. Who would've thought? This place is great."

- Olvar D: "I'm having all these feelings. I've never been allowed to have feelings. I think I'm having feelings about my feelings. And feelings about that. Wow. Being outside is a lot of work, isn't it?"
- Olvar D: "You don't see the animals go into war with each other. Nope, they all just get along. I wonder what they eat."
Olvar D: "Horrek, would you like help with-"
Jarka: "The Corpus boy is easy target. Very slow and very stupid."
- Jarka: "Or is he? Perhaps it is all Jarka's clever trap. Perhaps anything that comes for the Corpus boy will DIE! Safer just to walk away, yes."
